# MapLibre GL JS

MapLibre GL JS 6.17.0, vendored from the official `maplibre-gl@6.17.0` npm package so the application does not depend on a third-party script CDN at startup. This version includes the fix for [GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jrc7-96c5-q579). License: [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). Map tiles, imagery and geocoding still require network access.
